population: 52 distinct original November 10 Nations Test first issues for senior national league-phase kickoffs on 2026-11-12 through 17, using each original first comprehensive decision cutoff, falling back to the original Test cutoff where absent. Explicit finite pre-November-19 roster. No R7 forecasts, features or labels are loaded. Other retained Brazil/European club batches before this boundary are inventory or separately named diagnostic panels and never added to overlapping samples.
families: Team = signed original Test attack/defence primary. Market = unchanged price-only projected score distribution replayed from one original Pinnacle 90-minute 1X2 + actual total capture, not an original authored or market issuance unless a separate original literal freeze proves it. XG = only the originally October-selected, actually frozen BSD-field model, only if its extra process data and pre-cutoff availability are verified. Its paired goals-only control measures the incremental process input. The original Current, fixed refreshes and the November 16 selected shared-tempo challenger share the goals data family and stay in a separately labelled sensitivity table. Historical Elo created after the matches is excluded. Twelve different xG weight recipes are not twelve information sources.
clocks: At the original comprehensive cutoff a prior forecast must have been signed and committed by that cutoff. No later snapshot can replace the original price. Also audit original Nov 16 repair and Nov 17 xG batch decision cutoffs as separate panels, without counting the same fixture twice or carrying their market between clocks. All choices in one comparison row must be originally computed from information available at that row's cutoff. A signed computation/commit that followed its own captured cutoff must still predate kickoff; original batch choices are not earlier issues or channel deliveries.

sources.team_and_comprehensive: sources.json pins the original roster, markets and separate final labels; the new audit reads only pairs, p12-p17 and r12-r17; it never calls the earlier R7 checker.

author: A normal author's actual first score requires the original visible first body and immutable channel/server identity, issuance binding and pre-kickoff clock. An archived comprehensive signature, research human opinion or a screenshot recap is insufficient. No receipts means zero scoring denominator, while signed-only coverage is reported separately.
counting: Preserve all registered, labelled, covered, absent and abstaining rows. On a named common-source subset report each primary's hits, truly exclusive wins, shared hits and all-missed; do not call a sole available source an exclusive winner. The union of the available primary picks after seeing the 90-minute result is an oracle bound, never a deployable accuracy or displayed Top3. Report it on the whole roster and the common subset and contrast with the best single on the same panel. Enumerate disagreement cases and per-fixture source/clock digests. A shared result source is not an independent feature. Archive-derived statistical forecasts are not the author's displayed decisions.
conditional_selector: Only for the original 52-match panel: early kickoff dates Nov 12-14 for fitting with verified labels observed AND committed by 2026-11-15T08:00:00Z. Later Nov 15-17 for one locked score. Do not import native later-batch prices or xG into training. With earlier expert and team disagreement, compute the market's log probability margin for its first vs the team's first minus the team's log probability margin favouring its own first. Two bins are fixed at zero. If there are any early market-only first-score rescues, apply one hard selector: in a bin with at least four earlier disagreements over at least two dates, at least two market-only rescues and more such rescues than team-only wins, take the market first; otherwise take team. No weight fit, threshold grid, after-the-fact bin changes, late-label or author/other output inputs. A market switch takes its entire matrix for matrix Top3/WDL/actual-line diagnostics. With no early exclusive rescue, stop without training or trying an alternative. Other families have no eligible distinct-source training window and stay descriptive.
decision: Stop the selector if early evidence is absent or if late paired primary net gain is nonpositive, or secondary metrics deteriorate. A historical apparent win still cannot substitute for unseen or actual delivered decisions. If original first-score union itself falls below the 20% target on a complete paired panel, note the exact deficit and retire selection-only changes for that panel. If the upper bound exceeds the target but few independent rescue cases are available, distinguish a numerical opportunity from evidence it can be selected before kickoff. Use this to reduce active research branches; no new standing or future experiment.
timing_disclosure: This recipe is registered before this audit reads its early or late outcomes. The November roster and the previous #77 aggregate results were already seen in earlier work; this is historical, not a project-wide blind evaluation. One extra diagnostic cohort may be reported from independently signed pre-November-19 evidence, separately with its own original times. No changes to any previous data or locked model.
